ideal_customer: First responders (paramedics, police officers, firefighters), occupational workers with physical demands, individuals with workplace injuries, chronic pain sufferers, and people recovering from sports injuries or motor vehicle accidents
problems_you_solve: Work-related injuries, chronic and acute pain, sports injuries, motor vehicle accident injuries, concussion management, pre/postoperative rehabilitation, return-to-work challenges, workplace injury prevention, functional ability limitations
demographics: Adults 25-65 years old, primarily working professionals in physically demanding occupations, includes veterans, corporate employees, and active individuals seeking evidence-based rehabilitation
what_makes_them_different: Specialized first responder programs, rapid physician referral system, multi-disciplinary care team (physio, chiro, massage, acupuncture), advanced gait scan technology, Rehab Rewards loyalty program, and virtual care options
